Memory-hard admission mints resist sybil floods: a new agent earns entry only by filling its own disk with a storage proof, gigabytes etched like water channels through karst.
A scout node, the falcon, re-samples every fresh identity's sectors; wrong or pre-shared data voids admission. Each puppet needs physically distinct drives, so storage cannot be rented in bulk.
Every puppet buys its own disks and re-attests alone - no bulk discount, cost grows linearly with N, while an honest agent mints once and pays once. Scarcity is ivory-grade.
